source.geometry: H01 human temporal cortex Layer-IV microdomain
source.surface_geometry: released H01 blood-vessel triangle surface, locally clipped, seam-welded and display-smoothed

display_repair.basis: closest released-surface endpoints corroborated by aligned repaired-centreline endpoints

model.domain: 3D tissue outside the released H01 blood-vessel object 715 surface

boundary_conditions.vessel_wall: Dirichlet pO2; 50 mmHg normoxia and 32 mmHg hypoxia scenarios
boundary_conditions.clipped_vessel_openings: numerically capped only at the crop faces

parameter_basis.citation: Buxton RB, Frank LR. J Cereb Blood Flow Metab. 1997;17:64-72.
parameter_basis.used_for: human-gray-matter diffusivity, solubility, and oxygen demand

parameter_basis.citation: Gagnon et al. Front Comput Neurosci. 2016;10:82.
parameter_basis.used_for: 3D steady pO2 equation and Michaelis-Menten consumption form

numerics.method: second-order 7-point finite differences; damped Newton; matrix-free preconditioned conjugate gradients

physical_volume.format: NumPy compressed archive; arrays named and unit-labelled
physical_volume.browser_use: audit/re-render master only; the live deck consumes field below

display.render_note: cyan/blue only; project display_indices and cache the field layer; never relabel as measured pO2

flow.direction: illustrative PCA-binned medial path derived from released object-715 surface

caveats: H01 supplies anatomy only: vessel-wall pO2, CMRO2, and flow direction are explicit literature-based scenario assumptions.
The master field is physical-unit pO2, but it is not an H01 measurement and is not fitted to the clinical cohort.
Consumption is spatially uniform because H01 morphology does not measure cell-resolved metabolic demand.
Object 715 is not labelled arterial or venous; the moving-particle path is explanatory and does not enter the PDE.
The cropped open vessel surface is capped only on crop faces for numerical closure; one documented 3.262-um display bridge remains in the deck mesh.
Clinical CMRO2 is global and comes from the Fick relation, not from this local H01 calculation.
